title: Hybrid Code-and-AI Web Automation with Self-Healing Selectors
oneLiner: Stagehand by Browserbase extends Playwright with atomic AI primitives (`act`, `extract`, `observe`) so developers can mix deterministic code with self-healing natural language browser actions.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Stagehand by Browserbase extends Playwright with atomic AI primitives (`act`, `extract`, `observe`) so developers can mix deterministic code with self-healing natural language browser actions.
configSnippet: "await stagehand.act('Click the Export CSV button'); const rows = await stagehand.extract('Extract table rows', schema);"
limitations: LLM inference on every `act` step adds latency compared to pure cached Playwright selectors.
